title: Audit the OTLP-Labeled Handler
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Audit the OTLP-Labeled Handler.
learning_objectives: Explain audit the otlp-labeled handler using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for audit the otlp-labeled handler
Assess failure and operational limits of audit the otlp-labeled handler
concepts_covered: Official OTLP JSON uses fields such as traceId/spanId and timeUnixNano; this handler decodes Go field names/fields and is not wired to a route.
OTLPHandler expects resourceSpans/scopeSpans/spans containing Span-shaped JSON.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
